nodes.label: Instagram untuk Itinerary Perjalanan
nodes.rationale: Core product concept: users don't just see photos or videos, but structured routes, daily schedules, estimated budgets, and activities they can save, edit, or copy.

nodes.label: Jalanin Rute Ini (Clone Itinerary)
nodes.rationale: Allows copying another creator's itinerary as a personal editable template. Differentiator function that validates user behavior to duplicate rather than planning from scratch.

nodes.label: Simpan Rute (Save Itinerary)
nodes.rationale: Saves itineraries to a personal collection to track user interest and engagement rates (Save Rate).

nodes.label: Creator Revenue Protection
nodes.rationale: During cloning, original creator's myLinkId is preserved for activities so affiliate commissions go to the original creator. The cloner can manually change it later.

nodes.label: OSM Map Stack
nodes.rationale: Builds interactive route maps and search components without relying on Google Maps APIs.

nodes.label: Manual Location Selection
nodes.rationale: Enables manual point picker on map for custom places that aren't indexed in public APIs.

nodes.label: App-first Design Principle
nodes.rationale: Prioritize app UI experience directly over marketing content for fast validation.

nodes.label: Task 1: Grid Layout
nodes.rationale: Design mosaic layout inspired by Instagram Explore to provide visual variation (1x1 standard cards and 2x2 large cards) for the feed cards.

nodes.label: Task 2: Hover Overlays
nodes.rationale: Hide default text details under cards and move them into a backdrop-filter glassmorphism overlay on hover to give a clean visual impression similar to Instagram.

nodes.label: Task 4: Card Click Interaction
nodes.rationale: Instantly scroll the window to the top on card click so that the user immediately sees the updated route details, map, and budget summary of the selected itinerary.

nodes.label: Task 5: Mobile Navigation
nodes.rationale: Synchronize bottom mobile navigation so the 'Jelajah' button accurately scrolls to the explore feed section on mobile layout without breaking the layout.

nodes.label: Custom Supabase REST API Integration
nodes.rationale: The application communicates with Supabase services (Auth and Storage) using direct HTTP fetch requests to Supabase REST endpoints (/auth/v1 and /storage/v1) instead of using the official Supabase JS SDK. This avoids SDK overhead and keeps the client lightweight.
